## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Cittasampayuttaduka* is an Abhidhamma text located within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Designated as Patthana 8.37, it is classified as a leaf section in the canonical structuring [SuttaCentral]. The text applies the causal and conditional relations of the *Paṭṭhāna* system to the Abhidhamma matrix dyad concerning phenomena associated with consciousness (*citta-sampayutta*) [SuttaCentral].
No direct external parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are cataloged by SuttaCentral or matched in DharmaNexus above the reporting threshold [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis by DharmaNexus reveals substantial formulaic text reuse within the *Paṭṭhāna* corpus itself, identifying 98 matching passages distributed across 16 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest share of textual reuse occurs with the *Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 2.10; 38 matches, 4,808 characters), the *Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.10; 12 matches), and the *Hetuduka, Duka* (Patthana 6.1; 10 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Additional recurring material is shared with related combinatorial sections such as *Cittasampayuttaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.41), *Sanidassanattika, Cittasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 16.68), and other relational dyads like the *Āsavasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.16) and *Hetusampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.3) [DharmaNexus].
